name: camayoc_check_variable_dependence
description: verification-and-liveness Q5: the variables the mechanism under a check depends on. The reader compares against what was changed; an empty result means no dependence is RECORDED, which is UNKNOWN — never 'independent'.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?check ?label ?variable WHERE { BIND(<{check}> AS ?check) ?check a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:dependsOnVariable ?variable . } ORDER BY ?variable
